coverage: Complete treatise in both English editions: named authorial figure, historical/legendary references and the specifically named illustrative snake. Generic commanders and dynasties excluded.

entities.name: Sun Tzu
entities.body: The military thinker traditionally credited with The Art of War.

entities.name: The Yellow Emperor
entities.body: Huangdi, a legendary ruler of ancient China.

entities.name: Chu
entities.body: Chuan Chu, also called Zhuan Zhu: a figure from ancient Wu renowned for daring.

entities.name: Kuei
entities.body: Ts’ao Kuei, also called Cao Gui: an ancient warrior cited as an example of courage.

entities.name: I Chih / Yi Zhi
entities.body: An adviser associated with the rise of the Yin dynasty, also known as Yi Yin.

entities.name: Lü Ya / Lu Ya
entities.body: The adviser also known as Jiang Ziya, associated with the rise of the Zhou dynasty.

entities.name: The shuai-jan
entities.body: The snake used to illustrate coordinated defense: striking one part brings the others to its aid.
